strategies.name: Trade desk rule: ORB with trend filter
strategies.desc: Opening range breakout taken only in the daily trend's direction, before 1 PM. Stop at the other side of the first 15-minute range (its middle if wide), target 2x the risk, stop to break-even at 1x, out by 3:15. This is the rule the Trade desk suggests live.

strategies.name: Opening range breakout (15 min)
strategies.desc: Wait for the first 15-minute candle. Go long when a later candle closes above its high, short below its low. Stop at the other end of the range; square off at 3:15.

strategies.name: Session average (VWAP) cross
strategies.desc: From 9:45, go long when price closes above the session's running average price and short when it closes below. Flips on each cross, up to 4 entries a day.

strategies.name: CPR open, every day
strategies.desc: If the 9:15 candle closes above the Central Pivot Range go long, below it go short. Stop at the pivot.

strategies.name: CPR open, narrow-CPR days only
strategies.desc: Same as above, but only on days when the CPR is narrower than 0.25% of the pivot, which traders read as a likely trending day.

strategies.name: Baseline: long 9:30 to 3:15 daily
strategies.desc: Buy at 9:30 and sell at 3:15 every day, for comparison.
